# dsh-panel-titlebar
English | 简体中文
Puts the sidebar's global panel entries where a Windows app usually keeps its navigation: in the cap
tion row, right after the **应用 / 编辑** menus.
## The problem
A DeepSeek Harness profile that installs a few panels (Plugins, Market, Schedules, Context insight,
Memory, More) renders every one of them as a full-width row at the top of the sidebar. On a laptop t
hat is roughly **240px of vertical space** taken from the session list, on every screen, permanently
at is roughly **240px of vertical space** taken from the session list, on every screen, permanently:
## What it changes
The rows keep their icons, labels, active state and click behaviour, and move into the caption band
as compact menu items sized like the menus they follow. The sidebar starts directly with the brand r
ow, the New session button and the workspace list:
The session stats that ship below the composer — turn and step counts, decode speed, token total, ca
che hit and the context meter — move up into the View tab row, right after its **…** launcher.
## How it works
- The navigation stays the sidebar plugin's own registration in `sidebar.panellist`. Nothing is copi
ed, wrapped, replaced or removed, so the **More** launcher, its pin/unpin menu, the active-panel hig

hlight and the analytics of the shipped entries are untouched.
- One stylesheet takes that existing
`nav` out of the sidebar's flex flow (`position: fixed`) and lays its rows out horizontally in the c
aption band. Row metrics follow the caption menus: 28px high, 14px text, 6px radius, secondary label

colour, hover and active from the theme tokens.
- The stylesheet is scoped to `html[data-windows-ti
tlebar]`, a marker only the Desktop preload sets. The plain Web GUI keeps the shipped vertical list.
- The left offset is **measured**, not hardcoded: the plugin reads the right edge of the preload-in
jected `[data-windows-menu]` host into `--dsh-panel-titlebar-left` and keeps it current, so collapsi

ng the sidebar (menu start moves 48px → 84px), switching locale, or resizing stays aligned.
- The en
tries work as a **toggle**: clicking the selected entry again returns to the conversation (`layout.s
electPanel(null)`, the same destination as a panel's own “back to chat”), instead of re-selecting th
e panel that is already open. The click is stopped before the shipped handler runs; the **More** lau

ncher never acts as a panel entry, so it keeps opening its menu.
- The stats keep their own registra
tion in `conversation.composer.dock` and their own dialogs; only their seat moves. The dock still re
nders the pills, but is positioned from the View tab row's **…** launcher (`--dsh-statbar-top` / `--
dsh-statbar-left`), vertically centred in that row. While the anchor is missing — no session, a pane
l page, a collapsed layout — the plugin removes `data-dsh-statbar` and the dock falls back to its sh
ipped place below the composer.
[该节后续省略]
## Requirements
- DeepSeek Harness **Desktop** on Windows — the caption row exists only there. The plain Web build h

as no caption band, so the plugin is inert by design.
- Harness `>= 0.2.1-0` (the sidebar that rende

rs `sidebar.panellist` rows with the More launcher).
- The panel entries themselves come from whatev
er else the profile installs; the plugin does not create any.
## Install
Through the Plugin Manager, pointing it at this checkout:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The manager writes the profile dependency, selects the bundle and applies the row. The change is liv
e without restarting the app; a page refresh is enough if the panel row does not appear immediately.
Once the package is published, the same call accepts the name instead of a path:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Manual equivalent — add a dependency on this checkout to the profile and insert its row in the profi
uivalent — add a dependency on this checkout to the profile and insert its row in the profile patch:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Uninstall
Disable or remove the `panel-titlebar` row (Plugin Manager: uninstall the `dsh-panel-titlebar` bundl
e). The sidebar returns to its shipped vertical list immediately; no other plugin is affected.
## Customize
| Want | Change |
| Start further from the menus | Override `--dsh-panel-titlebar-left` on `:root` (defaults to the me

asured menubar edge + 10px) |
[该节后续省略]
## Compatibility and limits
- The rules address the shipped sidebar's CSS-module class suffixes (`panelRow`, `panelTitle`, `pane
lGlyph`) and the `nav` that owns the panel rows. A sidebar rewrite in a future Harness release may n
eed this plugin updated; the client module is loaded after `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar` for

that reason.
- The caption band is 40px tall and does not wrap: on a narrow window the trailing entr

ies ellipsize and are eventually clipped instead of pushing the window controls.
- The **More** popo

ver keeps its shipped anchoring (measured from the trigger button when it opens).
- The stats move r
elies on the View tab row exposing either its `…` launcher (`button.viewsMore*`) or the `viewTabs` c
ontainer, and on `[data-composer-dock]` carrying only ambient stat entries. A profile that adds its
own ambient panel to that dock would move it along; without any anchor the dock stays where it shipp

ed.
- Moving the dock relies on its `position: fixed` box resolving against the viewport. Harness `0
.2.2` promotes the composer seat with `will-change: transform` (a containing block for fixed descend
ants); the stylesheet withdraws that hint while the dock is hoisted, at the cost of the seat's compo
sitor layer while stats sit in the header. If a future build captures the fixed box by an actual `tr
ansform` or `contain`, the landed-box check drops the marker and the stats return below the composer

rather than overlapping it.
- Verified on Windows 11 with DSH Desktop (harness `0.2.1-rc.5`) at 150
% display scaling: placement, live install, and the reclaimed sidebar space. Hover and the More popo
ver reuse the shipped components; they were exercised manually, and CI covers the static contract on
reuse the shipped components; they were exercised manually, and CI covers the static contract only.
